features.title: Everything you need, nothing you don't

features.items.title: Your week on one screen
features.items.text: Seven columns, zero friction. Create a slot in one click and instantly see where you stand.

features.items.title: Full week & month calendar
features.items.text: Switch between week and month view, navigate in one click, and open the full record for any appointment.

features.items.title: Self-service booking
features.items.text: Share your public link: contacts pick an open slot themselves, you just confirm.

features.items.title: Confirmation by link
features.items.text: Every appointment generates a unique link. Your guest accepts or declines, and you see it live.

features.items.title: Email invitations
features.items.text: Send the invite to your contact in one click, with all the details and the response link.

features.items.title: Contact records
features.items.text: Company, role, phone, history: the context is there before you even say hello.

features.items.title: Prep notes
features.items.text: Jot down what you want to cover. Private, always at hand right before the appointment.

features.items.title: Light & dark
